title: Scratchpad: cross-team coverage manifest & short-run effort estimates (Apr 12 2026)
content:
Purpose:
This is a throwaway/working manifest to align cross-team owners for a short-run coverage window (72h) around an expected burst on the hosted API (mid-Apr 2026). Goal is a minimal, sharable single-pane tracker to decide who picks what lanes, estimate effort, and capture quick mitigations for gaps.

How to use:
- Fill in primary + backup owners for each lane.
- Give a conservative hours/week estimate for the immediate 72h window.
- Mark risk and blockers (low/med/high).
- Note any prefetched or cached mitigations (e.g., route-level prefix caches, temporary throttles).

---
Manifest (columns: lane | primary | backup | est hrs/72h | coverage window | risk | quick mitigations | blockers)

1) API surface: public/generate (latency-sensitive) | Lina Chen | Priya Rao | 12-18h | Apr 15 00:00 - Apr 18 00:00 UTC | high | - Canary lower-seq model (M-quant-2) on overflow
- Shorten max tokens for low-priority routes
| - Unknown surge shape from partner X; need rate forecasts

2) Embeddings bulk ingestion (batch workers) | Noah Summers | Gavin Li | 8-12h | Apr 15 06:00 - Apr 17 18:00 UTC | med | - Enable local batching window extension (2s)
- Pre-warm pooling nodes in us-west1
| - Scheduled customer bulk jobs; confirm we can reschedule non-urgent jobs

3) Admin/internal tools (console traces + rollout UI) | Priya Rao | Aisha Malik | 4-6h | Apr 15 00:00 - Apr 16 23:59 UTC | low | - Read-only mode for traces >10min
| - Console auth token rotation scheduled (confirm no collision)

4) Dedicated fallback routing (failover policy lanes) | Gavin Li | Lina Chen | 6-10h | Apr 15 00:00 - Apr 18 00:00 UTC | med | - Pre-seed fallback model variants and update routing rules
| - Need approval for temporary SLA exception for demo accounts

5) Private deployment telemetry (on-prem customers) | Aisha Malik | (unassigned) | 3-5h | Apr 15 09:00 - Apr 17 09:00 UTC | med | - Ask private ops to increase log retention to 48h for troubleshooting
| - On-call mismatch for EMEA night window

6) Billing & rate-limit support lane (customer credit ops) | Lina Chen | Noah Summers | 2-4h | Apr 15 08:00 - Apr 16 20:00 UTC | med | - Temp manual approvals for a small set of enterprise requests
| - Need Finance sign-off for one-off credits

7) Observability spike triage (dashboards/traces/alerts) | Observability rota (oncall) | SRE-bounce-pool | 10-14h | Apr 15 - Apr 18 24/7 | high | - Push a focused sampling rule to 1% for non-critical traces
- Enable ad-hoc retention for top 5 routes
| - Alert noise expected; may need quick suppression rules

Heatmap snapshot (quick visual; H=high, M=med, L=low):
- public/generate: H
- embeddings-bulk: M
- admin-console: L
- fallback-routing: M
- private-telemetry: M
- billing: M
- observability: H

Quick math (conservative): total headcount-hours across lanes (72h window) = ~45-69h (rough) -> equivalent to ~6-10 person-days of focused effort split across 4-6 folks.

Open questions / unknowns:
- Exact time distribution of partner X burst (need hourly forecast) -> action: Lina to ping Partner Eng for 4-hr bins (due Apr 13 17:00).
- Capacity we can borrow from pre-seeded dedicated pools without breaking other customers (Gavin to confirm pool slack by Apr 14 EOD).
- Any legal constraints for temporary crediting of accounts (Finance to confirm by Apr 14).

Action items (owner | action | ETA):
- Lina Chen | Request hourly load forecast from Partner Eng; share in thread | 2026-04-13 17:00 UTC
- Gavin Li | Validate spare capacity in dev/qa dedicated pools for pre-seeding | 2026-04-14 18:00 UTC
- Priya Rao | Lock down console read-only toggle and test rollback | 2026-04-14 12:00 UTC
- Noah Summers | Reschedule non-urgent bulk ingestion jobs for Apr 18+ | 2026-04-14 09:00 UTC
- Aisha Malik | Reach out to private ops for telemetry retention change | 2026-04-13 12:00 UTC

Risks & fallback playbook (short):
- If public/generate latency > target for >15m: trigger canary-fallback to M-quant-2 and notify SRE & product-ops; open high-priority incident and put banner on console.
- If embeddings backlog grows > 2x baseline: throttle non-critical batch jobs and increase per-instance batching window.
- If billing ops needs approvals and Finance is delayed: pre-authorize a capped manual credit pool ($5k) for emergency use (Finance must sign within 24h after).

Notes to self / scratch ideas:
- Consider a small temporary rate-limiter at edge for partner X traffic path only (edge-lane throttle 10 req/s per tenant) as an option versus full-service throttle.
- We should capture a post-mortem template that maps to these lanes so action owners can be auto-populated.

Short checklist before handoff to oncall:
- [ ] Confirm owners listed above have accepted the lane (Slack ping + Acknowledgement)
- [ ] Pre-seed fallback model variants (Gavin)
- [ ] Add sampling suppression rules (Observability)
notes_summary: Working, short-run cross-team coverage manifest for an expected mid-April burst. Assigns lanes, conservative effort estimates, open questions and short mitigations. Draft for alignment and quick handoff to oncall.
